|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 1 June 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Djas Puhr (V) (Virtual Set 2)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Power +3 under "nighttime conditions." Blaster Rifle counts as a "matching weapon" for Djas Puhr, and deploys on him and fires for free. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 5 when armed with a weapon).”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Power +3 under ‘nighttime conditions’. Blaster Rifle deploys and fires for free on (and is a matching weapon for) Djas Puhr. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 5 while armed with a weapon).” '''What changed:''' “"nighttime conditions."” → “‘nighttime conditions’.”; removed “counts as a "matching weapon" for Djas Puhr, and”; removed “on him”; “free.” → “free on (and is a matching weapon for) Djas Puhr.”; “when” → “while”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards2.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards2.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 3, slip 30. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Djas Puhr]].
